description:
Retire the private in-process repository and executor setups of the `cli_repo_workflow` suite.

## Background

Shared test support constructs an initialised file-backed repository from caller-supplied configuration and an executor over a file-backed root, and builds memory stores and executors from declarations passed as data. Most tests in this target spawn `jit`, but these helpers build an in-process repository or executor of their own. Its sibling `executor_with_interruptions` builds failure-injected storage that is the test's own subject, and stays. The in-process setups of the other `cli_repo_workflow` files belong to their own migrations.

`ordinary_executor` is `pub(super)` and `profile_concurrency_tests.rs` also calls it; this entry moves that caller to the shared constructor in the same change.

Helpers to retire, from the mechanical sweep in investigation §D.6 (function names are the identity; lines at `a5aac64b1`):

- `crates/jit/tests/cli_repo_workflow/profile_publication_tests.rs`: `ordinary_executor` (`:117`).

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Each helper under "Helpers to retire" no longer exists, and the tests that called it obtain what it built from the shared fixtures.
- [hard] REQ-02: No file in this entry's footprint defines a function that creates an in-process repository, store or executor of its own; each obtains it from the shared constructors, and no test writes an index body or restates a value product initialisation already writes, and scenario values (for example `enforce_leases = "off"`) reach the shared constructor as declarations.
- [hard] REQ-03: Each affected test asserts what it asserted before.
title: cli_repo_workflow in-process tests use the shared constructors
